instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Pull my Pinterest pins and boards", and give it nothing more: every input is optional.
2. The AI calls do_one_thing_in_my_account at @tools with method tools:run, tool tool:pull-my-pinterest-pins and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: Reads the pins and boards of the account the token belongs to (needs a token with pins:read and boards:read) and answers each. It stops at the first page held already (held), so a pull after the first reads only what is new; a pin or board pulled again has its fields refreshed.
4. It reads and writes no rows: the new or changed conversations and items are in the answer, and held.cursor is what to hand back next time.
